boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten named Stony Brook University library environments spanning quiet, silent, and collaborative work settings.

cards.title: North Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Frank Melville, Jr. Memorial Library · quiet collaborative area
cards.notes: Set up at an individual, paired, or group seat, then use the integrated printing, scanning, or screen-sharing tools as your work requires.
cards.short_summary: A large, technology-equipped reading room with varied seating.
cards.evidence_claim: The North Reading Room is a quiet collaborative area with individual, pair, and group seating, 44 computer workstations, 700+ outlets, and 12 group study rooms.
cards.source_title: Places to study | Stony Brook University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located in Frank Melville, Jr. Memorial Library; check the Libraries & Hours page before visiting.

cards.title: Central Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Frank Melville, Jr. Memorial Library · quiet collaborative area
cards.notes: Choose individual, paired, or group seating and keep an eye out for the reading nook when a newspaper or popular-magazine break fits your plan.
cards.short_summary: A collaborative room with technology, reading material, and multiple seating modes.
cards.evidence_claim: The Central Reading Room is a quiet collaborative area with individual, pair, and group seating, printing, scanning, screen sharing, and a reading nook.
cards.source_title: Places to study | Stony Brook University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located in Frank Melville, Jr. Memorial Library; check the Libraries & Hours page before visiting.

cards.title: Second Floor Core
cards.subtitle: Frank Melville, Jr. Memorial Library · silent study area
cards.notes: Enter through the North Reading Room and use this silent area when you need a book-lined setting with reference, maps, and government information nearby.
cards.short_summary: A silent library core with science and engineering materials.
cards.evidence_claim: The Second Floor Core is accessible through the North Reading Room and is a silent study area with 171 seats and four solo study rooms.
cards.source_title: Places to study | Stony Brook University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Access is through the North Reading Room; the library identifies this as a silent study area.

cards.title: Galleria
cards.subtitle: Frank Melville, Jr. Memorial Library · first floor
cards.notes: Use a chair or bench beneath the skylights for collaborative laptop work, and bring a charged device or use one of the listed electrical outlets.
cards.evidence_claim: The Galleria is a first-floor collaborative area with four-story ceilings, large skylights, 73 chair seats, six benches, and 38 outlets.
cards.source_title: Places to study | Stony Brook University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located on the first floor of Frank Melville, Jr. Memorial Library; the library describes it as collaborative.

cards.title: Main Stacks
cards.subtitle: Frank Melville, Jr. Memorial Library · third floor
cards.notes: Pick a small table, study carrel, or lounge chair on the third floor when you want to work close to circulating books and media collections.
cards.short_summary: A silent third-floor setting with extensive carrel seating.
cards.evidence_claim: The Main Stacks are a silent study area on the third floor with 56 small-table seats, 199 study carrels, lounge chairs, and 276+ outlets.
cards.source_title: Places to study | Stony Brook University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located on the third floor of Frank Melville, Jr. Memorial Library; the library identifies it as a silent study area.

cards.title: Music Library
cards.subtitle: Frank Melville, Jr. Memorial Library · first floor
cards.notes: Use a table, lounge chair, computer station, or listening station while consulting music media, scores, books, and other music resources.
cards.short_summary: A silent study environment built around music collections and listening stations.
cards.evidence_claim: The Music Library is a silent study area on the first floor with listening stations, Mac and Dell computer stations, study tables, and lounge chairs.
cards.source_title: Places to study | Stony Brook University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located on the first floor of Frank Melville, Jr. Memorial Library; check library hours before visiting.

cards.title: Health Sciences Library
cards.subtitle: Health Sciences Tower · third floor
cards.notes: Bring health-sciences research to a carrel, small table, group table, or lounge seat, with charging available from the library’s listed outlets.
cards.short_summary: A Health Sciences Tower library with carrels, tables, and collaborative seating.
cards.evidence_claim: The Health Sciences Library is on the third floor of the Health Sciences Tower and provides computer workstations, 184 study carrels, group tables, and 600+ outlets.
cards.source_title: Places to study | Stony Brook University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located on the third floor of the Health Sciences Tower; check the Libraries & Hours page before visiting.

cards.title: Chemistry Library
cards.subtitle: Chemistry Building · second floor
cards.notes: Work from a small table, carrel, lounge chair, or computer workstation on the second floor when your course materials are chemistry-focused.
cards.short_summary: A compact subject library with tables, carrels, lounge seating, and computers.
cards.evidence_claim: The Chemistry Library is on the second floor of the Chemistry Building and has eight computer workstations, 66 small-table seats, five carrels, and eight lounge chairs.
cards.source_title: Places to study | Stony Brook University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located on the second floor of the Chemistry Building; check the Libraries & Hours page before visiting.

cards.title: Mathematics/Physics/Astronomy Library
cards.subtitle: Physics Building · C floor
cards.notes: Choose a small table, carrel, lounge chair, or computer station on the Physics Building’s C floor for mathematics, physics, or astronomy work.
cards.short_summary: A subject library with nearly 100 small-table study seats.
cards.evidence_claim: The Mathematics/Physics/Astronomy Library is on the C floor of the Physics Building and includes 12 computer workstations, 99 small-table seats, 14 carrels, and lounge seating.
cards.source_title: Places to study | Stony Brook University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located on the C floor of the Physics Building; check the Libraries & Hours page before visiting.

cards.entity_name: North Reading Room Solo Study Rooms
cards.title: North Reading Room Solo Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Frank Melville, Jr. Memorial Library · reservation required
cards.notes: Reserve one of the four solo rooms for individual academic work, an online class, or an interview, and plan within the published daily and weekly limits.
cards.short_summary: Reservable individual rooms for focused academic work and online commitments.
cards.evidence_claim: Solo Study Rooms are located in the North Reading Room and are for individual study, interviews, and online classes; current undergraduate and graduate students may reserve them.
cards.source_title: Study Rooms | Stony Brook University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Current undergraduate and graduate students may reserve; solo rooms have a four-hour daily and 16-hour weekly limit.
